verify_detail: per launch and never reset except by `pm clear` (or uninstall/reinstall). Any test suite that cold-launches the app repeatedly without clearing app data will land on the "skip" launches (#3, #5, #8, #10, #13, #15…) roughly 2 times out of every 5, giving the observed ~60% pass rate. The fix isn\'t a flakiness workaround — the test needs to either clear app data before each run (deterministic), or assert on `launchCount % 5 ∈ {2,4}` as the expected no-button state instead of treating it as a bug.'
